clue.text: Section of social club volunteers basic food

explanation.walkthrough: 'Section of' takes CIA from inside 'social'; 'social club' looks like one phrase but splits across two jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian flat white loaf, an everyday staple bread, so an example of a basic food.

clue.text: Artist entered privately

taken as written

clue.text: Monk's spades placed in bucket

clue.text: After sign of hesitation, girl carries right form of protection

clue.text: Pancetta regularly sliced in minutes

clue.text: Cleaner engine part having coils fixed by granddad?

clue.text: Red toenails clashing with mini

clue.text: Agree to fare

clue.text: Others hacked lines in PC account?

clue.text: By any standard, a position of respect
